title: Permit-bound worker request materializer
goal: Freeze a one-shot permit into the proven Legion worker request contract without dispatching it.
laws: Request binds exact permit SHA-256 and qwen3-builder identity.
Node is legion and capability is engineering.patch only.
Workspace is explicit; allowed paths are non-empty safe relative paths.
Deny paths, exact task and bounded timeout are frozen before dispatch.
Request status is READY_FOR_DISPATCH; permit remains unconsumed.
No worker/model process starts in this mission.
